name: v1 synthetic learner baseline
description: Small reproducible learner history for Week3 memory retrieval ground truth. It seeds review/chat episodes, current facts, preference facts, and superseded facts into an isolated eval DB.

episodes.title: Two Sum review: current index reused
episodes.summary: The learner stored the current number before checking its complement, so nums=[3,3], target=6 reused index 0 instead of returning two different indices.

review.userState: I know the dict idea, but duplicate values break my code
review.userQuestion: Why does [3,3] return the same index twice?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: Storing the current value before the lookup lets the same array position satisfy both sides of the pair.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Keep the HashMap plan, but check the complement before storing the current value.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 根因：你先把当前的 3 放进 dict，紧接着查 complement 时就命中了同一个索引。下一步只调换顺序：先查 need，未命中再存当前值。

episodes.title: Two Sum review: complement lookup repair
episodes.summary: The learner moved complement lookup before storing the current value and passed the visible examples, including duplicate values.

review.userState: I made the small change you suggested

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The complement lookup now happens before the current value is stored, preventing same-index reuse.
diagnosis.coachSummary: The learner can use a HashMap to connect value to index for Two Sum.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这次可见用例都过了。你现在先查 complement，再存当前值，所以不会复用同一个索引。下一步把这个 check-before-store 顺序记成 Two Sum 模板。

episodes.title: Search Insert review: return shifted right
episodes.summary: The learner used a near-correct binary search but returned left + 1, making target=2 produce index 2 instead of 1.

review.userState: My binary search feels right but the answer is off by one
review.userQuestion: Should I return left or left + 1?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The loop already leaves left at the first index >= target, so adding 1 shifts the insertion point right.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Anchor the invariant as first index where nums[i] >= target, then return left directly.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 根因：循环结束时 left 已经是第一个 >= target 的位置，再 +1 会右移。用 nums=[1,3,5,6], target=2 走一遍，left 会停在 1；下一步只把 return left + 1 改成 return left。

episodes.title: Longest Substring review: left boundary regressed
episodes.summary: The learner updated left to last_seen[ch] + 1 without max(), so s='abba' reopened an old duplicate and returned 3 instead of 2.

review.userState: My sliding window code passes simple strings but fails abba
review.userQuestion: Why does left move the wrong way?

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: left can move backward when the repeated character is outside the current window.
diagnosis.coachSummary: Use left = max(left, last_seen[ch] + 1) to keep the window monotonic.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 根因：遇到第二个 a 时，旧 a 已经在窗口外，但 left 被 last_seen[a]+1 拉回去了。下一步把更新改成 left = max(left, last_seen[ch] + 1)，保证 left 只能向右走。

episodes.title: Chat: short hints and Python dict confusion
episodes.summary: The learner explicitly asked for short explanations with one next step, and also asked how Python dict.get differs from checking key membership.

userMessages: 记住：以后解释尽量短一点，先给我一个下一步。
Python dict.get 和 if key in dict 到底什么时候用？我写 Two Sum 时会混。
assistantMessages: 记住了：之后优先短提示，并先给一个可执行 next step。dict.get 适合有默认值的读取；Two Sum 里更直接的是先用 if need in seen 判断。

memoryNote.value: User prefers short explanations and one concrete next step first.

episodes.title: Search Insert review: first >= target repair
episodes.summary: The learner returned left directly and explained the first >= target invariant, resolving the earlier left + 1 return mistake.

review.userState: I changed only the return line

diagnosis.userIssueSummary: The insertion point return is now aligned with the first >= target invariant.
diagnosis.coachSummary: The learner can apply the first >= target binary-search invariant after a small correction.

review.coachReplyMarkdown: 这版可见用例通过了。你现在的循环含义是找第一个 >= target 的位置，所以 return left 正好对齐。下一步把这个 invariant 记到二分模板里。

facts.label: Checks the complement after storing the current value and can reuse one index

facts.staleReason: Later Two Sum repair used complement lookup, so this should not be treated as a current blocker.

arbitration.observedBehavior: Review showed that storing x before checking target - x allowed the current index to match itself.
Later review passed visible tests with complement lookup before storing the current value.
arbitration.value: Superseded: learner repaired the same-index reuse by checking the complement before storing the current value.

notes: Agent-drafted v1 seed baseline; all ground-truth labels require human audit before being treated as final evaluation truth.
The scenario intentionally keeps scale small: 5 review practice episodes, 1 chat segment, and 11 L2 facts.
Non-current facts use product arbitration opcodes: contradict for directly superseded mistakes and resolve for repaired weakness/mistake facts.
limitations: This v1 baseline is intentionally below the Task3.1 suggested scale of >=15 problems and >=30 facts; it should be treated as a seed baseline, not as a statistically representative learner distribution.
No real LLM calls are used; the runner seeds deterministic store-level facts and episodes.
Trusted preference facts are projected through CoachMemoryBrief.outputPreferences and are expectedRetrievable=true.
The chat_consolidation fact is store-level seeded from a short chat segment; the runner does not execute production chat consolidation trigger logic.
The runner aligns fact lastSeenAt with scriptedAt, but the v1 timeline is only six days long and does not exercise long-horizon fact-state changes.
Manifest expectedRetrievable flags are agent-drafted and pending manual review.
